scope: One locally authored AC1024 model-space solid HATCH and closed straight LWPOLYLINE on macOS ARM64.
procedure: Build the current consumer with the installed shared codec, changing only the scratch application's QSettings organization name to isolate user preferences; restore the source after the build and ad-hoc-sign the scratch app.
Open the authored source in the native GUI, observe the filled contour, save a separate AC1024 copy, and reopen it.

Select both entities using the native Select All command, use Move / Copy with originals disabled and reference (0,0) to target (1,2), save another AC1024 copy and reopen it. The moved filled contour is visible after reopen.

ezdxf independently reads source, native save and native moved save: one associative HATCH and one closed LWPOLYLINE, reciprocal boundary/reactor identities, matching model-space owner and contour edges, exact expected coordinates and zero audit errors or fixes.
limits: This tests one local source, one move and one macOS ARM64 GUI configuration. It does not qualify arbitrary edits, copying, other producer graphs, Linux/Windows or general HATCH support.
The isolated application binary differs from the candidate only in its settings organization. No source or saved drawing fixture is committed.
